timing: After all eight v33 mitotic fits completed. One incidental real-seed learned MRR (0.05295643399051719) was seen in a log; no full baseline/test comparison was reviewed. Before corrected fitting or interphase effect analysis. This is a transparent correction, not external preregistration.

correction.reason: Absolute image centroids violate the original feature policy and can encode position/batch. The original selector omitted this naming pattern. Original model runs remain preserved and excluded from gain claims.

preparation.add: Per-guide, per-plate full counts, feature sums and finite counts for separate-plate sensitivity; no query-specific selection.
preparation.storage_review: Mitotic export is partitioned by guides: 20404 total per-shard guide records equal 20404 distinct guides; prepared output 8063718534 bytes. Three interphase schema-only samples have 1, 8 and 5 guides per shard. The feared intermediate explosion was not supported; retain checksum-bound sharded preparation with a resource guard.

models.controls: Four real and four shuffled fits per arm; all eight idle H100s. Same original gene split, sampling, architecture, optimizer and validation checkpoint rule.

baseline_details.abundance: Within-arm log1p counts; observed mitotic fraction after both exports complete. Never call this viability.
baseline_details.required_baselines: Fail if declared basic/size features are absent; report variable-feature exclusions rather than silently drop a baseline.

aggregate_analysis.unit: Held-out genes; guides and seeds are dependent repeats.
aggregate_analysis.interval: Paired percentile 95% interval. Within each bootstrap draw subtract the maximum simple-baseline macro-MRR; report each seed and minimum-over-four-seeds joint interval.
aggregate_analysis.gain_gate: All four real seeds exceed the strongest simple baseline by >=0.02 absolute macro-MRR; each paired lower bound and joint lower bound >0. Report shuffled controls separately. No clinical interpretation.
aggregate_analysis.topk: Macro-average guide fractions within each gene, then genes; report ties explicitly.

plate_sensitivity.comparison: Query each eligible guide on one plate against distinct-guide gene references pooled only from other plates. Exclude the query guide from its own gene reference. Use training-gene preprocessing.
plate_sensitivity.interpretation: Plate-separated retrieval; the pooled model has seen training-gene cells from all plates. This is not a completely unseen-acquisition test or biological replication. Preserve insufficient plate/guide coverage.
plate_sensitivity.methods: Full cosine/correlation, basic/size, abundance and learned profiles from the same fixed sampled cells; report sampled-cell counts and missing states.

numerical_validation.mitotic_replay: Exact original vs corrected guide metadata, sample identities and retained sample columns; full sums/counts/means must agree after excluding four centroid columns.
numerical_validation.independent_summary: CPU float64 recomputation for all ten named queries, with separately implemented reduction and source checksum checks.

unchanged: No drug priority, phase, exposure, wet-lab or clinical promotion
